title: Demon Slayer Peaked Early, But Infinity Castle Can Save It
content: The Demon Slayer anime peaked early thanks to its first season and movie, but the series still has the potential to surpass that success. The reason for its early success wasn’t its epic storytelling but rather Ufotable’s fascinating anime adaptation.

title: 3 Things You Need to Know for Sakamoto Days Season 2
content: 2027 is going to be another exciting year for anime fans, especially since fans will get to watch the sequel seasons of their beloved shows. Sakamoto Days is one of those anticipated series that will return with another season.

title: 22 Years Ago, Studio Ghibli’s Most Whimsical Anti-War Movie Was Released & It Holds Up Even Today
content: Howl’s Moving Castle remains one of the most whimsical fantasies of all time, even 22 years after its premiere. Founded by directors Hayao Miyazaki and Isao Takahata and producer Toshio Suzuki in 1985, Studio Ghibli eventually became one of the most globally renowned animation studios of all time.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach’s Hell Arc Deserves to Return With New Sequel
content: There’s still one final Bleach arc that’s left to tell its story, and fans deserve to see it come to fruition one day to continue from Tite Kubo’s original series. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War ended its official anime run earlier this Fall to cap over 22 years of the anime franchise .
